deviations_from_adr: No ADR for this task — mechanical follow-up from T-0720's B1 review finding (epic T-0585, open_question in T-0720.pr-handoff.json), same as T-0720 itself was a follow-up from T-0697's review. This DOES deviate from T-0639.spec.md §2.2's literal quoted tier-1 text ('...подмена вступит в силу автоматически, если этот держатель станет недоступен...') and from T-0639's own ux-review.json/test-report.json which accepted that exact wording as honest at the time (per T-0588 §1.3+AC-5's original design assumption that a Tier-1 substitute always already holds the role via their own role_assignment). That assumption does not hold in the current code: registerSubstitute's pool query (src/http/rights-intents.ts:775-783) excludes ONLY absent_employee_id and substitute_employee_id from the pool-holder check — it does not require the nominated substitute to already hold the role. T-0720's judge (B1 block) established, for the identical registerSelfAbsence code shape, that no tier1->tier2 auto-escalation/re-mint mechanism exists (ttl_grant_id stays NULL forever) and that the shared inbox.ts claim-gate (resolveTier2SubstitutionClaim, line ~1378: `r.ttlGrantId !== null // Tier-1 substitutes already hold the role via role_assignment`) filters OUT tier1 rules from claim-eligibility credit — so a tier1 substitute without their own independent role_assignment gets 403 NOT_ELIGIBLE regardless of the rule. Since inbox.ts's claim-gate is shared (does not distinguish rule origin/source field) and registerSubstitute's tier-split logic is byte-identical in shape to registerSelfAbsence's, the same finding applies here. T-0639's own spec/review artifacts were left UNTOUCHED (historical record of what was believed/reviewed at the time, same precedent T-0720 set for not editing T-0697's artifacts) — the correction lives in this task's own diff + this handoff.

No new server-side test was added for the substitute (admin) path's tier1-no-mint invariant (mirroring the self-absence path's s5 test in rights-intents.self-absence.authz.test.ts). Not needed: registerSubstitute's tier-split code (src/http/rights-intents.ts:772-921) is the identical `if (tier2) { mint } ` shape already covered by reading the source, and the claim-gate that matters (resolveTier2SubstitutionClaim) is shared code already exercised by the self-absence authz tests plus src/__tests__/rights-intents.test.ts's I-1/I-2 narrowing tests. 2. Pick employee A as 'Отсутствует' for role R in scope S, where role R has a KNOWN second confirmed holder OTHER than A (a 'pool-covered' role) — nominate employee B (who does NOT already hold role R) as 'Замещает'. Set an until-date. Submit.

Confirm its tier1 banner text matches SubstituteForm's tier1 banner text verbatim except for the opening clause ('Отсутствие объявлено' vs 'Правило подмены создано') — a reader should not notice the two forms were fixed in different tasks (T-0720 vs T-0731).
